original_abi: All four bodies consume only ECX; return full EAX via C3 RET, ESP+=4, no callee argument cleanup and no consumed EDX/stack arguments. Getter reads are raw dwords at wrapping ECX+C or ECX+38. LEA returns uint32 ECX+1AC with no dereference, preserves flags and accepts ECX=0. BDD0 reads +4 once, reads +8 only when begin!=0, wraps SUB32 then signed-divides12. All complete strict and registered bytes match, including all register/flags/load/fault ordering. x87 state/FIP are untouched. Original class, semantic field types and formal convention spelling unrecovered; Source single-argument fastcall matches measured physical input. Code placement/caller adoption/game ABI is not claimed.
uncertainties: Names, original class ownership, field meaning and original formal C++ types are not recovered.
Whole entry-body identity is not caller integration, installed binary replacement, Native execution or game validation.
signed_quotient_proof: After uint32 wrapping subtraction, preserve all bits into int32 and divide by 12, including negative differences and INT_MIN. Native magic m=0x2AAAAAAB satisfies 12*m=2^33+4; arithmetic product-high/shift yields floor(x*m/2^33), then the sign correction truncates toward zero. Error magnitude <=1/12; the endpoint INT_MIN has remainder8, so no boundary exception. Final whole emitted instruction identity independently confirms this physical computation.
